Cook onion and garlic in oil; add grated tomato, spices and water; simmer 15 min.
Add kefta; cover; simmer 20 min to core 72 °C.
Crack 10 eggs over; cover 6–8 min until whites set; parsley.
3858cdde.st: Kefta sauce: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Add eggs to order.

c: Chicken thigh 1800 g raw → ≈ 1300 g cooked
Grind walnuts fine; toast dry 8–10 min stirring.
Simmer with water 60 min, stirring, until the oil separates and the paste darkens.
Brown chicken pieces with onion and turmeric; add to the walnut base with molasses, cinnamon and sugar.
Simmer 40 min (core 80 °C); balance sweet-sour with sugar or molasses.
Scatter pomegranate seeds; serve with Chelow TTK.

f0a5f9e2.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 300 g tagine + 150 g couscous
c: Cut lamb into 4 cm cubes; toss with spices and salt; marinate 2 h.
Brown in oil in batches; sweat onion, garlic and ginger 6 min.
Add lamb, tomatoes, water and saffron; cover; braise 160 °C 1 h 30 min.
Add apricots, honey and chickpeas; braise 30 min more until tender; reduce if thin.
Finish with coriander and toasted almonds.
Pour boiling salted water over the couscous; cover 5 min; fluff with butter.

5801fcc6.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 160 g lamb + rice & sauce ≈ 520 g
c: Lamb leg 3000 g raw on bone → ≈ 1600 g cooked meat
Blanch lamb pieces; simmer with water, onion and spices 1.5–2 h until tender; strain stock.
Whisk yoghurts with starch until smooth; heat, stirring in one direction, until it simmers (prevents splitting).
Add 800 ml lamb stock and the lamb; simmer 20 min; season.
Cook rice with ghee, turmeric, water and salt 18 min; rest 10 min.
Line platter with thin bread moistened with sauce; mound rice; top with lamb.
Spoon over yoghurt sauce; garnish with ghee-toasted almonds, pine nuts and parsley. Extra sauce alongside.
5801fcc6.st: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat sauce gently to 75 °C, stirring.
5801fcc6.al: 1 Gluten (pita bread) · 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%, greek yoghurt 10%, ghee) · 8 Nuts (almonds, pine nuts)

c: Chicken 1500 g raw → ≈ 1100 g cooked; 1100 ml stock
Simmer chicken with aromatics 30 min; lift chicken; strain and keep 1100 ml stock.
Fry sliced aubergine, cauliflower florets and potato slices golden at 175 °C; drain.
Layer in an oiled pot: tomato slices, chicken, vegetables, then washed rice mixed with spices and salt.
Pour hot stock to 2 cm above the rice; cover; simmer low 35 min; rest 15 min.
Invert onto a tray; garnish with ghee-toasted almonds and pine nuts.

037115b9.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 1 leg + bread & onions ≈ 400 g
c: Chicken legs 3000 g raw → ≈ 2000 g roasted on bone
Marinate legs with half the oil, spices, lemon and salt 4 h at 0–4 °C.
Roast 200 °C 40–45 min to core 80 °C; keep pan juices.
Cook sliced onions slowly in oil 30–40 min until soft and sweet; add sumac, allspice, salt and pan juices.
Open flatbreads; brush with onion oil; spread onions; top with chicken.
Bake 220 °C 6–8 min until bread edges crisp.
Finish with toasted pine nuts and parsley; serve with yoghurt.

517bf093.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 130 g fish + 90 g sauce
c: Portion 160 g; season with oil, lemon and salt.
Sweat onion, chilli and garlic in oil until soft; add cumin.
Whisk tahini, lemon and water smooth; add to pan; simmer 3 min.
Coat fish; flash under the grill 2–3 min; top with chopped coriander and walnuts.
517bf093.st: Sauce: 0–4 °C, 3 days. Cook fish to order.

d5ca23d9.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 130 g fish + 250 g rice
c: Season fish with cumin, oil, lemon and salt.
Fry sliced onions until very dark brown (not burnt); keep half for garnish.
Blend the other half with hot stock to a brown, sweet broth.
Cook washed rice with broth and spices covered 18 min; rest 10 min.
Top rice with fish, crisp onions and toasted nuts. Serve with tahini sauce and lemon.
d5ca23d9.st: Rice: 0–4 °C, 24 h; reheat to 75 °C. Cook fish to order.
d5ca23d9.al: 4 Fish (hake fillet, fish stock) · 8 Nuts (pine nuts, almonds) · 9 Celery (fish stock)

c81d69b4.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 120 g = 1200 g · Portion: 120 g
c: Prep. Dice onion and carrot 5 mm; chop parsley. Bring vegetable stock to the boil.
Sweat. Sweat onion and carrot in oil 5 min, no colour; add bulgur, stir 2 min until nutty.
Cook. Add hot stock (2.2 : 1) and salt; cover, cook on low heat 12 min, or combi steam 100 °C in GN, 15 min.
Rest. Rest covered 10 min; fluff with a fork, fold in parsley.
Hold. Covered ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h. Leftovers spread thin, blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min; reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.
c81d69b4.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 48 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

c: Wash rice until clear; soak in salted water 2–4 h.
Boil in plenty of salted water 6–7 min until al dente; drain; rinse lukewarm.
Tahdig: mix 400 g rice with yoghurt, half the oil and half the bloomed saffron; press into a hot oiled pot.
Mound remaining rice; poke steam holes; drizzle butter; cover lid with a cloth.
Cook 10 min medium, then 45 min low. Invert; serve crust in wedges with saffron rice on top.
828c7cae.st: Best fresh. Rice: 0–4 °C, 24 h; reheat to 75 °C.

9b2d1c9f.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 170 g chicken + 200 g rice
c: Chicken legs 2500 g raw → ≈ 1700 g roasted on bone; 1400 ml broth
Brown chicken in ghee; remove. Fry onion and garlic; add tomato, paste, spices and pierced loomi.
Return chicken; add water; simmer 35 min.
Lift chicken; roast 220 °C 12 min to crisp (core 80 °C). Strain broth (1400 ml).
Wash and soak rice 20 min; cook in boiling broth covered on low 18 min; rest 10 min.
Plump raisins in ghee; toast almonds.
Mound rice; top with chicken, raisins and almonds. Serve with tomato daqqus.

0501aef4.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 120 g = 1200 g · Portion: 120 g
c: Prep. Chop parsley and mint finely just before use.
Liquid. Boil water with salt and half the oil.
Hydrate. Couscous in GN 1/1 × 65 mm; pour over boiling liquid, stir once, cover tightly 8 min.
Finish. Fluff, breaking all lumps; fold in remaining oil, lemon juice and herbs. Core ≥ 75 °C (steam 100 °C, 5 min if needed).
Hold. ≥ 63 °C lightly covered, max 2 h; replace with a fresh half GN. Leftovers blast-chill \< 5 °C in 90 min.
0501aef4.st: Blast-chill to \< 5 °C in 90 min; 0–4 °C, 48 h. Reheat to ≥ 75 °C core.

c: Par-boil soaked rice 6 min in salted water; drain.
Cook carrot julienne in butter with sugar 5 min; add orange peel.
Plump barberries in butter 1 min (they burn fast).
Layer rice with carrot mixture and spices; steam covered 40 min on low.
Fold through saffron water; top with barberries, pistachios and toasted almonds.
a7b743a9.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (pistachios, almonds) · 14 Sulphites (candied orange peel). Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

c: Spread 80 g grated cheeses along the centre; fold the long edges over and twist the ends into a boat.
Bake 250 °C 8 min; crack an egg into the centre; bake 3–4 min more until white is set.
Brush edges with melted butter; sprinkle nigella; cut into strips.
705a0589.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, kashkaval, mozzarella, butter). Vegetarian.

8db6a383.yl: Yield: 20 pita (10 portions) · Portion: 2 pita ≈ 110 g
c: Knead 8 min to a smooth dough; prove 1 h at 26 °C.
Divide 20 × 58 g; ball; rest 15 min covered.
Roll 15 cm discs, 4 mm thick; rest 10 min.
Bake on a preheated stone or tray at 260 °C 3–4 min until puffed; wrap in a cloth at once.
8db6a383.st: Wrapped: 24 h; frozen 1 month. Refresh 180 °C 1 min.

ea9a06c3.yl: Yield: 10 pcs · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 220 g with garnish
c: Roll very thin to 30 cm ovals.
Mince onion, pepper, tomato, garlic and half the parsley very fine; drain; mix with lamb, pastes and spices.
Spread 120 g thinly over each base to the edges.
Bake on a stone at 260 °C 5–6 min until edges crisp and meat is cooked.
Serve with sumac onion, parsley, romaine and lemon to roll.
ea9a06c3.st: Topping raw: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Bake to order.

f4a82827.yl: Yield: 10 pcs · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 190 g with garnish
c: Stretch to 20 cm; dimple with fingertips.
Mix za'atar, sesame and oil to a loose paste; spread 30 g per disc.
Bake 250 °C 6–8 min until edges are golden.
Serve with sliced tomato, cucumber and mint.
f4a82827.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 11 Sesame (za'atar, sesame seeds). Vegan.

c: Simmer lentils 15 min until half-cooked; keep the liquid.
Slice onions thin; fry slowly 25–30 min until deep brown and crisp; drain; keep the oil.
Add washed rice, spices, salt and 30 ml onion oil to the lentils; top up to 2 cm over; cover; cook 18 min; rest 10 min.
Fold in half the onions; top with the rest. Serve with yoghurt and salad.
658d767b.st: 0–4 °C, 3 days; reheat to 75 °C. Keep onions dry, separate.
658d767b.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Wash and soak rice 20 min; drain.
Fry broken vermicelli in ghee, stirring, until evenly deep golden.
Add rice; stir 1 min to coat; add boiling salted water.
Cover; cook on low 15 min; rest 10 min off heat; fluff.
Toast whole spices (allspice, pepper, cloves, coriander, cardamom) 2 min; cool.
Mix with ground cinnamon, nutmeg and ginger.
85b73f29.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Chop herbs, garlic and preserved-lemon rind finely (or pulse coarse).
Mix with spices, lemon, oil and salt.
Use as a marinade for fish/chicken (2–4 h) or as a sauce.
315f2c50.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Roast hazelnuts 160 °C 10 min; rub off skins.
Toast sesame, then the seeds separately until fragrant.
Pulse nuts and spices to a coarse crumb (not paste); mix with sesame and salt.
Red peppers 400 g → ≈ 250 g roasted, peeled
Seed chillies; soak in hot water 30 min; drain.
Roast peppers 220 °C until blistered; peel and seed.
Blend everything to a smooth paste; jar; cover with oil.
5467b1ad.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Peel turnips; cut into 1 cm batons; slice beetroot.
Pack into a sterilised jar with garlic and bay.
Dissolve salt in warm water; add vinegar; cool; pour over to cover.
Seal; keep at room temperature 5–7 days until pink and tangy; then refrigerate.
bfcfef48.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Scrub lemons; quarter from the top leaving the base joined.
Pack each with 1 Tbsp coarse salt; press into a sterilised jar with spices.
Top with lemon juice to cover; seal.
Cure 4 weeks at room temperature, turning the jar every few days. Use rinsed rind only.
abfd4644.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Toast whole seeds, pods, allspice, cloves and pepper 2 min; cool.
e27d5a73.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Spread the sesame on a tray; toast at 160 °C convection 8–10 min, stirring once or twice.
Grind on high speed, adding the oil gradually, until smooth; scrape down as needed. Season with salt.
5e968a7d.st: 0–4 °C, 1 month in a sealed jar; −18 °C, 6 months. Stir before use.

c: Process garlic and salt to a smooth paste, scraping down.
With the motor running, add oil in a thin stream; every 150 ml oil add a little lemon and ice water.
Stop when thick, white and fluffy.
4b8dc177.st: 0–4 °C, 14 days, covered. Never hold at room temperature.
4b8dc177.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Toast sesame until light golden; cool.
Rub dried oregano and thyme fine between palms or pulse briefly.
Mix with sumac, sesame and salt.
Toast and grind cumin if using seeds.
Pulse herbs, chilli and garlic to a coarse paste (do not purée).
Add spices, lemon, oil and salt; jar; cover with a thin film of oil.
bcdaf08d.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Rinse tea with 100 ml boiling water 30 s; discard.
Add 2 L boiling water; steep 3 min.
Add spearmint sprigs and sugar; steep 3 min.
Pour high into a glass and back into the pot 3× to mix and froth; serve in small glasses.
b456de49.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Whisk to a pourable batter; rest 30 min until bubbly.
Cook 8 cm pancakes on one side only on a hot griddle until the top is dry and holed.
Cool under a cloth; pinch half of each edge to make a cone.
Ashta: whip ricotta with cream and blossom water until smooth.
Syrup: boil sugar, water and lemon 6 min; add rose water; cool.
Pipe cream into the open side; dip in ground pistachio; drizzle syrup at service.
874c3c74.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, semolina) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, ricotta, cream 33%) · 8 Nuts (pistachios). Vegetarian.

c: Whisk yoghurt with salt until smooth; whisk in ice-cold water to a frothy drink (or blend 30 s).
Serve very cold with a mint sprig.

fbbfe54f.yl: Yield: 1 tray GN 1/1 · 24 portions · Portion: 120 g
c: Mix the walnuts, cinnamon and 80 g sugar.
Brush the tray with clarified butter. Lay one third of the filo sheets, brushing each with butter.
Spread the nut mixture evenly; cover with the remaining sheets, buttering each; press lightly.
Score into 24 portions through to the base.
Bake in a convection oven at 170 °C for 35–40 min until deep golden.
Boil all together for 5 min. Cool completely.
Pour the cold syrup over the hot baklava straight from the oven.
Rest a minimum of 4 h at ambient, then cut through the score lines; portion at 120 g.

c051ca13.yl: Yield: 1 tray 30 × 40 cm · 20 pcs · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 100 g
c: Mix semolina, coconut, sugar and baking powder; add yoghurt, butter and milk; rest 15 min.
Spread 2 cm thick; score into 20 diamonds; press an almond on each.
Boil sugar, water and lemon 8 min; add blossom water; cool.
Pour cool syrup over the hot cake; rest 2 h before cutting.
c051ca13.al: 1 Gluten (coarse semolina) · 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%, butter, milk 3%) · 8 Nuts (almonds) · 11 Sesame (tahini). Vegetarian.

24580985.yl: Yield: 1 tray 30 × 40 cm · 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 175 g
c: Chop kadaif finely; rub with melted ghee.
Press half firmly into a buttered tray; spread grated mozzarella mixed with ricotta; top with remaining kadaif; press.
Invert; pour cold syrup over the hot knafeh; sprinkle chopped pistachio. Serve warm.
Boil sugar, water and lemon 8 min; add blossom and rose water; cool.
24580985.al: 1 Gluten (kadaif pastry) · 7 Milk (ghee, mozzarella, ricotta) · 8 Nuts (pistachios). Vegetarian.

c: Rub semolina and flour with melted ghee; cover; rest 8 h (overnight) at room temperature.
Add sugar, mahleb, yeast, blossom/rose water and milk; knead briefly; rest 30 min.
Wrap 25 g dough around 12 g filling; press into a ma'amoul mould; tap out.
Bake 180 °C 18–20 min until just pale golden; cool; dust with icing sugar.
Date: knead dates with butter and cinnamon; roll 12 g balls.
Walnut: chop walnuts; mix with sugar and blossom water.
00d1c96f.al: 1 Gluten (coarse semolina, wheat flour) · 7 Milk (ghee, milk 3%, butter) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Vegetarian.

c: Whisk starch with 300 ml cold milk.
Bring remaining milk, cream and sugar to the boil; whisk in the slurry; cook 3–4 min until thick.
Off the heat add blossom and rose water; pour 140 g cups; cool; chill ≥ 3 h at 0–4 °C.
Top with rose syrup and chopped pistachio.

0716fb05.yl: Yield: 1 × 24 cm cake · 12 portions · Portion: ≈ 85 g
c: Rub almond flour, flour, sugars and butter to crumbs; press 150 g into a lined tin as a base.
Whisk eggs, yoghurt, spices, zest and rose water into the remainder; pour over base.
Bake 175 °C 35–40 min until set; cool in tin.
Mix icing sugar, lemon and rose water; spread on cooled cake; scatter chopped pistachio.
0716fb05.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, greek yoghurt 10%) · 8 Nuts (almond flour, pistachios). Vegetarian.

c: Whisk starch with 300 ml cold milk.
Heat remaining milk, cream and sugar; whisk in slurry; simmer 3–4 min until it coats a spoon.
Serve hot topped with cinnamon, chopped pistachio and coconut.
99c64cd5.st: Make to order; hold hot ≥ 63 °C, 1 h.

c: Soak rice 1 h; simmer in water 40 min, stirring, until very soft and creamy.
Stir in bloomed saffron, butter, rose water, cardamom and almonds; cook 10 min on low until glossy.
Pour into bowls; cool; decorate with cinnamon lines and pistachio. Chill.

52afe711.yl: Yield: Tray 40 × 30 cm · 48 pieces · Portion: 70 g
c: Bring milk and sugar to the boil, stirring; simmer 2 min; add vanilla.
Cool and chill to 4 °C (cold syrup goes onto the hot baklava).
Brush the tray with butter. Lay half the filo, brushing every sheet with clarified butter.
Spread the chopped pistachios evenly; cover with the rest of the filo, buttering every sheet.
Chill 20 min, then cut into 48 diamonds or squares through to the base; pour the remaining butter over.
Bake at 170 °C convection 45–50 min until deep golden and crisp.
Ladle the cold milk syrup evenly over the hot baklava; leave to absorb ≥ 3 h at room temperature, then chill.
Sprinkle ground pistachio on each piece. Serve cool, ≤ 8 °C.
52afe711.st: Soaked baklava: 0–4 °C, 72 h (milk syrup). Do not freeze after soaking.

c: Combine and cook without stirring to 120 °C.
Dissolve the starch in the cold water; heat, whisking, until thick.
Toast the walnuts at 160 °C convection 6–8 min.
Pour the hot syrup slowly into the starch base, whisking constantly.
Cook on low heat, stirring constantly, 45–60 min until thick, elastic and pale golden.
Pour into a 20×20 cm tin lined with oiled paper; level; leave to set at 18–22 °C for 8–10 h.
Mix 7:3. Cut the lokum into 2.5 cm cubes and roll in the coating.
1f3633df.st: Airtight, dry store 15–20 °C, 14 days (low water activity; chilling makes it sweat); −18 °C, 3 months.

c: Per cup in a cezve: 70 ml cold water, 7 g coffee, sugar to order (sade / orta / şekerli), pinch of cardamom; stir once.
Heat slowly on low until foam rises (about 2–3 min); do not boil.
Spoon foam into the cup; bring to a rise again; pour.
Serve with a glass of water and a piece of Turkish delight.
bd3feecf.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan. Gluten-free.

c: Bake puff pastry sheets 200 °C 15 min until crisp; break into pieces.
Layer in a dish with nuts, raisins and coconut.
Boil milk, sugar and half the cream; pour over; soak 5 min.
Top with lightly whipped remaining cream; bake 220 °C 12–15 min until golden-blistered. Serve hot.
ee4f1c8d.al: 1 Gluten (puff pastry) · 7 Milk (puff pastry, milk 3%, cream 33%) · 8 Nuts (pistachios, almonds, walnuts). Vegetarian.

c: Trim and wash the greens three times; cut into 4 cm lengths.
Blanch in boiling salted water 4 min; refresh in iced water; squeeze out hard.
Slice onions thinly; fry in 100 g oil at 160 °C 12–15 min until deep golden; drain on paper.
Sauté garlic in remaining oil 30 s; add greens and half the onions; toss 3 min; season; add lemon juice.
Cool to 21 °C within 2 h; serve at room temperature topped with crisp onions and lemon wedges.
e02feb94.st: 0–3 °C 72 h; onions separately in an airtight box 48 h.

c: Top the beans and cut into 5 cm lengths.
Sweat onion and half the garlic in oil 8 min without colour.
Add beans; toss 5 min; add grated tomato, paste, sugar, spices, salt and water.
Cover and stew on low heat 35–40 min until the beans are tender and the sauce clings; add remaining crushed garlic for the last 5 min.
Cool to 21 °C within 2 h; serve at room temperature with pita.
Char aubergines whole over an open flame or under a salamander 15–20 min, turning, until collapsed.
Peel; drain flesh in a colander 20 min; chop coarsely.
Dice tomato and pepper 5 mm (seed the tomato); slice spring onion; chop parsley.
Whisk garlic, lemon, molasses, salt and oil; fold through the aubergine and vegetables.
Plate; finish with pomegranate seeds and a thread of oil.
5ea72039.st: 0–3 °C 48 h; dress the vegetables to order.

c: If shanklish is unavailable: crumble dry feta, roll into 4 cm balls, coat in za'atar and chilli; air-dry uncovered at 0–3 °C 48 h.
Crumble the cheese balls into coarse pieces.
Seed and dice tomatoes 1 cm; slice onion thinly; pick parsley.
Toss vegetables gently with cheese; dress with olive oil; no salt is needed.
4882c868.st: Cheese balls 0–3 °C 14 days; assemble to order.
4882c868.al: 7 Milk (feta cheese, dry) · 11 Sesame (za'atar). Contains milk, sesame.

c: Grate courgettes coarsely; salt with 6 g and drain 20 min; squeeze dry.
Sauté in oil over high heat 6–8 min until dry and lightly coloured; cool to 5 °C.
Crush garlic with remaining salt; mix with yoghurt, lemon and half the mint.
Fold in the courgette; finish with oil and mint rubbed between the palms.
Peel aubergines in stripes; salt 30 min; rinse and dry; fry at 175 °C 5–6 min until golden; drain.
Brown lamb with onion, baharat and salt; add toasted pine nuts.
Slit aubergines lengthwise; open into pockets; fill generously with lamb.
Lay in a tray; pour over passata, paste, water, garlic and salt; bake at 180 °C 35 min; core ≥75 °C.
Cut cauliflower into 5 cm florets; blanch 2 min; dry well on racks.
Tarator: whisk tahini, lemon, garlic and salt; add iced water gradually until it coats a spoon.
Deep-fry florets at 175 °C 5–6 min until deep golden; drain; season with salt and cumin.
Serve hot, drizzled with tarator, parsley and pomegranate.
Peel potatoes; cut 1 cm dice; rinse and dry.
Sauté in oil 15–18 min, tossing, until golden and tender.
Add garlic and half the coriander 1 min.
Pour in beaten, seasoned eggs; fold gently 2 min until just set; core ≥72 °C.
Finish with remaining coriander and sumac.
ab172644.st: Cook to order; diced potatoes in water 0–3 °C 24 h.

c: Mix meat, fat, salt, spices, garlic and wine at ≤4 °C; fold in toasted pine nuts. Fry a test piece.
Fill into casings; twist into 8 cm links; dry uncovered on racks at 0–3 °C overnight.
Pan-fry in oil 8–10 min until browned; core ≥72 °C.
Deglaze with molasses and lemon; toss to glaze; serve at once.
01ae1531.al: 8 Nuts (pine nuts) · 14 Sulphites (red wine). Contains nuts, sulphites.

c: Chop herbs, spring onion and onion finely.
Whisk eggs with flour, baking powder, spice and salt; fold in herbs.
Ladle 50 g rounds into 3 mm hot oil; fry 2 min each side until puffed and golden; core ≥72 °C.
Serve hot or warm with garlic yoghurt or in pita.
f9b677f0.al: 1 Gluten (plain flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs). Contains gluten, eggs.

c: Boil potatoes in their skins; peel and rice while hot. Rinse bulgur and soak 15 min; squeeze.
Knead potato, bulgur, flour, cumin and salt to a firm dough.
Filling: cook sliced onion in oil 25 min until soft and golden; add chopped walnuts, sumac and chilli.
Press half the dough into an oiled tray, spread filling, cover with remaining dough; score into diamonds; brush with oil.
c9386a26.al: 1 Gluten (fine bulgur, plain flour) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Contains gluten, nuts.

c: Shell: knead rice, bulgur, lean beef, salt and water to a smooth dough. Filling: brown beef with onion, spice and salt; add parsley; cool.
Shape 30 g shells around 15 g filling into flat discs; chill 30 min.
Sweat onion and garlic in oil; add paste 2 min; add stock, diced turnip and courgette; simmer 20 min.
Lower in kubba; simmer gently 20 min until they float and are firm; add shredded chard 5 min.
Season with lemon and dried mint until clearly sour; core ≥75 °C. Serve 3 kubba per bowl.
4e442766.al: 1 Gluten (fine bulgur) · 9 Celery (beef stock). Contains gluten, celery.

c: Soak chickpeas 12 h with bicarbonate; rinse.
Simmer in fresh water 1 h 15 min until tender; keep 200 g cooking liquid.
Pound garlic with salt and cumin; whisk with lemon and oil.
Toss hot chickpeas with dressing and a splash of liquid; top with parsley and toasted pine nuts.
fbf2bcca.st: Cooked chickpeas in liquid 0–3 °C 4 days; reheat to ≥75 °C.

c: Dice cucumber, seeded tomato, onion and pepper into even 5 mm cubes.
Chop herbs; combine with vegetables at ≤5 °C.
Dress with lemon, oil, sumac and salt just before service.
Thin tahini with lemon and water; spoon over each portion.
Cover chicken with cold water; bring to the boil; skim; add onion, carrot, celery and whole spices; simmer 1 h 15 min.
Strain; pick meat into shreds; dice the carrot.
Toast vermicelli in butter until golden; add to the broth and simmer 6 min.
Return chicken and carrot; season; finish with lemon and parsley; core ≥75 °C.
7088774d.st: 0–3 °C 72 h; add vermicelli to reheated soup if holding longer.
7088774d.al: 1 Gluten (vermicelli) · 3 Eggs (vermicelli) · 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (celery). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, celery.

c: Simmer lentils in stock 25 min; add diced potato and cook 15 min.
Sweat onion in half the oil 10 min; add to the pot with shredded chard stalks, then leaves after 5 min.
Fry crushed garlic and chopped coriander in remaining oil 1 min (the taqliyeh); stir in with cumin.
Season with lemon and salt; core ≥75 °C.
Peel aubergines in stripes; fry whole at 175 °C 6 min; drain; slit and stuff with lamb browned with onion, baharat and salt.
Lay in a tray; cover with passata and garlic; bake at 180 °C 30 min; core ≥75 °C.
Cut pita into squares; bake at 190 °C 8 min until crisp.
Whisk yoghurt with tahini, crushed garlic and salt at room temperature.
Plate: bread, two aubergines with sauce, yoghurt over; top with pine nuts fried in foaming butter.
57f00871.st: Baked aubergines 0–3 °C 72 h; bread airtight 3 days.
57f00871.al: 1 Gluten (pita bread) · 7 Milk (greek yoghurt, strained, butter) · 8 Nuts (pine nuts) · 11 Sesame (tahini). Contains gluten, milk, nuts, sesame.

c: Rinse bulgur, squeeze and rest 15 min; process lean lamb with onion, baharat and salt to a paste; knead in bulgur with a little iced water (keep ≤5 °C). Shape 40 g torpedoes around 15 g filling (lamb, onion and pine nuts cooked and cooled).
Whisk yoghurt with cornflour, egg white and salt; heat slowly, stirring one way, until it boils and stabilises (5–8 min).
Add kibbeh; simmer gently 15 min; core ≥75 °C.
Fry crushed garlic and mint in butter 30 s; stir into the pot.
6129bb3e.al: 1 Gluten (fine bulgur) · 3 Eggs (egg whites) · 7 Milk (natural yoghurt, butter) · 8 Nuts (pine nuts). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, nuts.

c: Knead dough 8 min; rest 30 min covered.
Brown lamb with onion, spice and salt; add toasted pine nuts; cool.
Roll dough 1.5 mm; cut 5 cm rounds; fill with 6 g; fold to a half-moon and join the corners into a ring.
Bake dumplings at 200 °C 10 min until lightly coloured (they hold shape in the sauce).
Stabilise yoghurt as for kibbeh labanieh; add dumplings and simmer 10 min; core ≥75 °C.
Finish with garlic and coriander fried in oil.
3e08e75c.st: Baked dumplings −18 °C 1 month; finished dish 0–3 °C 48 h.
3e08e75c.al: 1 Gluten (plain flour) · 3 Eggs (egg whites) · 7 Milk (natural yoghurt) · 8 Nuts (pine nuts). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, nuts.

c: Mix meatball ingredients; roll 25 g balls; chill 20 min.
Brown balls in oil in batches; set aside. Fry pine nuts in the same pan until golden; remove.
Cook onion cut in petals 10 min; add paste, passata, molasses, water, cinnamon and salt; simmer 15 min.
Return meatballs; simmer 20 min; core ≥75 °C. Finish with pine nuts.
Grate onion and squeeze out the juice; chop parsley very finely.
Mix meats, onion, parsley, spices and salt at ≤4 °C; knead 3 min until tacky; rest 1 h at 0–3 °C.
Shape 90 g portions onto flat skewers, pressing ridges with the fingers.
Grill over high charcoal 3–4 min each side; core ≥72 °C. Grill tomato halves alongside.
Serve on pita with sumac onions and grilled tomato.
Mix lamb, fat, salt and spices; knead until sticky; roll 20 g walnut-sized balls; chill.
Simmer cherries with sugar, water, cinnamon and lemon 20 min until syrupy; keep warm.
Grill meatballs on skewers 6–8 min, turning; core ≥72 °C.
Toss meatballs in the cherry sauce 3 min.
Plate on pita pieces; finish with pine nuts fried in butter and parsley.
05a0a5c2.al: 1 Gluten (pita bread) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (pine nuts). Contains gluten, milk, nuts.

c: Spatchcock the poussins (6 × 1 kg, halved after cooking); slash thighs.
Blend garlic, lemon, oil, spices and salt; rub over the birds; marinate 6–12 h at 0–3 °C.
Grill skin-side up over medium charcoal 15 min, turn and grill 10–12 min, basting; core ≥75 °C at the thigh.
Rest 5 min; halve; serve with toum, pickles and fries or pita.
Split carp along the back and open flat (spine left in the belly half); rinse; pat dry.
Rub with salt, turmeric and oil; rest 30 min at 0–3 °C.
Grill skin-side down on a rack over hot coals (or 250 °C oven grill) 20–25 min until the flesh flakes; core ≥63 °C.
Top with tamarind, sliced tomato and onion tossed with curry powder; grill 5 min more.
Serve with lemon, pickles and bread.
031f359e.st: Cook to order; prepared fish 0–3 °C 24 h.

c: Mix kafta; press into a GN 1/1 in a 1.5 cm layer (or form flat patties).
Cut potatoes in 5 mm rounds; fry or roast at 220 °C with oil 15 min until half-cooked.
Layer potatoes, tomato slices, pepper and onion over the kafta; season.
Pour over passata thinned with 200 g water; cover; bake at 190 °C 30 min, uncover 15 min; core ≥75 °C.
Cut stalks off and hollow courgettes with a corer leaving 4 mm walls (keep the flesh for ijjeh).
Mix washed rice, raw lamb, melted butter, spice and salt; fill each courgette two-thirds full.
Lay in a rondeau; cover with passata, paste, water and salt; weigh down with a plate.
Simmer covered 45 min until rice is cooked; core ≥75 °C. Add garlic pounded with mint and lemon for the last 5 min.
Cut lamb 3 cm; brown in oil in batches.
Add onion 8 min and garlic 1 min; add paste 2 min.
Add passata, water and spices; simmer covered 1 h until tender.
Add diced carrot 15 min, then peas 8 min; season; finish with coriander and garlic; core ≥75 °C.
Cut lamb 2 cm; brown in oil; add onion, garlic and hawaij; add grated tomato and stock; simmer 1 h.
Add diced potato; cook 20 min; season.
Hulba: soak fenugreek in water 4 h; pour off the bitter water; whip with fresh water, lemon and zhoug to a stiff froth.
To serve: heat portions in stone or cast-iron bowls until bubbling; crack in egg and scramble lightly; core ≥75 °C; top with hulba. Serve with flatbread.
c85ba232.al: 3 Eggs (eggs) · 9 Celery (lamb stock). Contains eggs, celery.

c: Poach chickens with onion and whole spices 1 h; core ≥75 °C; lift out, shred meat; strain stock.
Brown lamb in butter with baharat; add washed rice and cinnamon; toss 2 min.
Add 1.6 kg stock; cover and cook 18 min; rest 10 min.
Fry nuts in oil until golden.
Plate rice; top with chicken and nuts; serve with yoghurt.
de453ab8.st: 0–3 °C 72 h; cool rice to ≤5 °C within 90 min.
de453ab8.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (almonds, flaked, pine nuts, cashew nuts) · 9 Celery (chicken stock). Contains milk, nuts, celery.

c: Cut lamb into 150 g pieces; brown in oil. Add onion 10 min, garlic, ginger and bzar 2 min.
Add tomato, pierced loomi, cinnamon, water and salt; simmer covered 1 h 30 min until tender.
Soak rice 30 min; lift out lamb; measure 2 kg stock into the pot; add rice; cover and cook 15 min.
Sprinkle saffron soaked in rose water; scatter raisins; steam on low 15 min.
Brown lamb under a salamander; serve on the rice with daqqus.
5385fd70.st: 0–3 °C 72 h; cool rice to ≤5 °C within 90 min.

c: Rub chicken with hawaij, garlic, oil and salt; marinate 4 h at 0–3 °C.
Roast on racks at 200 °C 40 min; core ≥75 °C.
Fry onion and whole spices in butter 10 min; add soaked rice and stock; cover and cook 15 min.
Lay chicken on the rice; place a foil cup with ghee in the centre and a glowing coal in it; cover tightly 10 min to smoke.
Garnish with raisins and almonds fried in butter.
f13846d7.st: 0–3 °C 72 h; cool rice to ≤5 °C within 90 min.

c: Rinse freekeh and pick out stones.
Brown diced lamb in butter; add onion 10 min, baharat and cinnamon.
Add freekeh; simmer covered 25 min until tender and the liquid is absorbed; rest 10 min.
2e3dd405.al: 1 Gluten (freekeh, cracked) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (almonds, flaked) · 9 Celery (lamb stock). Contains gluten, milk, nuts, celery.

c: Knead dough 10 min; prove 1 h at 26 °C.
Divide into 110 g; roll into 50 cm ropes and join into long oval rings.
Dip in molasses thinned with water, then in sesame on both sides.
Prove 20 min; bake at 230 °C 12–14 min until deep golden.
Serve with za'atar, olive oil and boiled egg.
d1482e9d.al: 1 Gluten (bread flour) · 7 Milk (milk) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Contains gluten, milk, sesame.

c: Soak pine nuts in water 1 h; drain.
Blend pine nuts, garlic and salt to a paste; add tahini and lemon.
Thin with iced water to a pourable sauce; fold in chopped parsley.
d48bf8fb.al: 8 Nuts (pine nuts) · 11 Sesame (tahini). Contains nuts, sesame.

c: Stem chillies; keep seeds for heat; chop coarsely.
Mince with garlic and salt; pack into a sterile jar; ferment 3 days at 18–20 °C, stirring daily.
Stir in lemon and vinegar (pH ≤4.2); cover with olive oil.
3de6d53e.st: 0–3 °C 2 months under oil; clean spoon only.

c: Toast cumin, pepper, coriander, cardamom and cloves in a dry pan 2–3 min until fragrant; cool.
Grind finely; sieve; mix with turmeric.
Fry garlic and chilli in oil 1 min; add paste 1 min; add tomato and cumin.
Simmer 20 min until thick; season with lime and salt; add coriander.
Serve warm or cold with machboos.
Ashta: whisk milk, cream, cornflour and sugar; boil 2 min stirring; add rose water; cool under film to ≤5 °C.
Toast semolina in butter over medium heat 15–20 min, stirring, until deep golden.
Boil sugar and water 3 min; pour carefully into the semolina (it spits); stir until it leaves the sides; add orange blossom water.
Press 1.5 cm thick into a tray; cool; spread ashta on top; scatter nuts; chill 2 h; cut squares.
e7cf2907.al: 1 Gluten (coarse semolina) · 7 Milk (butter, clarified, milk, double cream) · 8 Nuts (pistachios, almonds, flaked). Contains gluten, milk, nuts.

c: Soak walnuts, pistachios, almonds and pine nuts in water 4 h (traditional) or use toasted.
Whisk rice flour, sugar and spices into cold water; bring to the boil stirring constantly; simmer 20 min until thick.
Pour into glasses; cool to 21 °C within 2 h and chill.
1876b123.al: 8 Nuts (walnuts, pistachios, almonds, flaked, pine nuts). Contains nuts.

c: Rub butter into flour, sugar, cardamom and salt; add yeast dissolved in warm milk; knead smooth; rest 30 min.
Warm date paste with butter, cardamom and rose water until spreadable; cool.
Roll dough 4 mm; spread with dates; roll up and cut 1.5 cm slices (or stuff into ma'amoul-style discs).
Brush with yolk; sprinkle sesame; bake at 180 °C 15–18 min until golden.
ad6a840f.al: 1 Gluten (plain flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter, milk) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, sesame.

c: Dried apricots, pressed sheet (qamar el din)
Tear apricot leather into pieces; soak in 2 kg hot water 4 h or overnight at 0–3 °C.
Blend smooth; add remaining cold water, sugar, lemon and orange blossom water; strain.
Chill to ≤5 °C; serve over ice with chopped pistachio.
